blocks.text: Tool-use platform that gives agents access to 250+ apps

Building tools for agents is mostly authentication. Composio solves that (OAuth flows, scoped tokens, refresh, multi-tenant credential storage) and exposes 250+ apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, GitHub) as agent-ready actions.
This is the layer that turns "the agent can write text" into "the agent can actually send the email, file the ticket, update the CRM" without you writing twenty auth flows.
We pair Composio with whatever agent framework the client is on: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI. It's framework-agnostic.
Gmail, Slack, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, GitHub, and more
Auth flows, token storage, and refresh handled for you
Works with Claude SDK, OpenAI Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI
Webhook triggers that fire agents on app events
Run the Composio server in your own infrastructure
Skipping the auth tax is worth real money. Composio is the fastest path from agent to genuine action across your stack.
Our engineers work with Composio daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
